Your bladder and pelvic floor do serious work. They lift, stabilise and give you strength. Made up of hardworking muscles and resilient tissues, like any part of your body that works hard, they deserve nourishment that truly understands them. At the heart of our formula is a rare strain of Cucurbita Pepo, only found in the Austrian. These nutrient-dense seeds are a plant-based source of L-Arginine — an amino acid found in our muscles and tissues. Precisely blended with bifidobacterium lactis and soy isoflavones — specifically selected for their quality, natural origin, and independent scientific research. This clever bacteria blended with isoflavones supports your urobiome with better absorption. Together, they form a daily foundation of support, designed to nourish the systems that matter most as we age. Vegan-friendly. Gluten-free. Made in the UK. For daily strength, steady support, and a body that backs you. At Jude, we believe our pelvic health is part of women’s strength — but it’s long been ignored, whispered about, or shrugged off as “just part of ageing.” Jude exists to change that. Jude was created to support people seeking strength, steadiness, and confidence with science-backed, stigma-free solutions rooted in care. Our approach is grounded in science, guided by deep respect for women’s biology, and refined alongside experts in bladder and muscle health. From supplements to pads to supportive communities, we’re building a new standard — one that puts dignity, confidence, and daily strength back into your hands.
